text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! To think I could catch this many.
choice_data_list: I'll give them all to Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ...I couldn't.
Trainer-san, you were the one who won it.
choice_data_list: I worked so hard because I wanted to make Messiah happy.
I worked so hard because I wanted to make Messiah happy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, well then.
May I give one as a present to my mother too?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Along with a letter explaining that Trainer was the one who took it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "I want to show them... that I'm spending my days happily with such a dependable Trainer."
